key.name: apps-menu
key.description: A category-based menu of installed applications.

key.name: apps-menu-shortcut
key.summary: Keybinding to open the applications menu

key.name: apps-menu-layout
key.description: “Accordion” is a single column whose categories start collapsed and open one at a time; “columns” keeps categories on the left and applications on the right, like the official Applications Menu.

key.name: apps-menu-icon-size
key.summary: Icon size in the applications menu

key.name: keyboard-uppercase
key.description: Shows “BR” instead of “br” in the keyboard layout indicator of the top bar and in its menu.

key.name: keyboard-always-visible
key.description: Keeps the layout indicator in the top bar even with a single layout; GNOME hides it when there is nothing to switch to.

key.name: button-order
key.summary: Order of the GnomeCustom buttons in the top bar
key.description: Module ids from left to right. The section of the bar (left, center or right) is chosen on the page of each module; this list decides who comes first among the buttons that share a section.

key.name: island-breaks
key.summary: Top bar buttons that start a new island
key.description: With the top bar drawn as islands, each listed button starts a new island within its section of the bar. Our buttons use the module id (“sysmon”, “bluetooth”); GNOME ones, their status area role (“keyboard”, “quickSettings”, “dateMenu”).
